opening.argument: Star Wallets promises a fixed one percent daily profit and full repayment of investment capital after 45 days. Those assurances are the core of its pitch for a passive staking opportunity. The presentation then directs viewers to fund a BNB wallet, purchase paid PINs, and stake at least $100, turning the promised returns into instructions to commit money. It also encourages recruitment by promising commissions from invited deposits. Taken together, the fixed earnings promise, capital repayment assurance, paid entry steps, and deposit-based recruitment establish a scam investment solicitation.
